articles.summary: A Classic Since Always™ – From Revolutionary Pinsetters to Everyday Family Traditions Lucky Strike Entertainment (NYSE: LUCK) today announced the launch of a refreshed identity for AMF (American Machine Foundry), one of the most iconic names in American bowling. Rooted in AMF's 126-year heritage, the rebrand positions the brand for the future and reflects its evolution into a modern bowling destination where families and communities come together for birthday parties, league nights, and social outings. AMF's refreshed shield logo marks a new chapter for an American classic. Founded in 1900 as American Machine Foundry, AMF helped shape modern bowling through innovations, including the automatic pinsetter and the world's first automatic scoring system. Over the decades, the brand played a significant role in expanding bowling's popularity across the United States and around the world, helping establish it as one of America's most participated-in sports. articles.title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Unveils Brand Refresh for AMF, Honoring an American Classic Families Have Always Loved

articles.summary: Beginning August 3, passholders will also receive a free lemonade or dirty soda with every visit through September 1 Lucky Strike Entertainment (NYSE: LUCK), one of the world's premier owner-operators of location-based entertainment, today announced a new Summer Season Pass offer. Beginning August 3 through September 1, guests can purchase Summer Season Passes for 25% off, while all passholders will receive one complimentary lemonade or dirty soda with every visit. As families look to make the most of the final weeks of summer, Lucky Strike Entertainment continues to invest in affordable experiences that encourage repeat visits and time together. The enhanced Summer Season Pass offer delivers even greater value, giving guests more reasons to return throughout the season. articles.summary: Company enhances the league experience while welcoming new and longtime bowlers nationwide Lucky Strike Entertainment (NYSE: LUCK), one of the world's premier owner-operators of location-based entertainment, is expanding its investment in league bowling with enhancements designed to strengthen the league experience for longtime bowlers while introducing more guests to the sport through League Open Houses taking place this week at 244 participating centers nationwide. As part of the company's continued commitment to league bowling, Lucky Strike Entertainment is investing in upgrades to lane conditioning and oil patterns across 270 centers, providing league bowlers with more consistent playing conditions and an enhanced experience on the lanes. More than 300,000 bowlers currently participate in leagues across the company's portfolio, reflecting the important role leagues continue to play across its nationwide network of centers.
